During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Roark Garnet/Legends|Roark Garnet]] fought an [[Unidentified Imperial (bathysphere)|Imperial]] for control of a [[bathysphere]] in the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of a '''Jovian''' [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]].

==Description==
A Jovian [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]], the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] had a [[Color/Legends|red]]-tinted viscous [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] with several cloud layers. The planet's [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] was higher than standard, with a [[Human/Legends|Human]] feeling like they weighed a least a hundred [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]] heavier when exposed to it. The lower layers of the planet's atmosphere had pressure levels of a thousand atmospheres, which was beyond the tolerance level of Humans. It was believed that the planet was devoid of life, but a [[Unidentified flying life form|gray, flying life form]] lived in the cloud layers.<ref name="RPG" />

==History==
At some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] assigned a [[bathysphere]] to operate in the planet's atmosphere. At some point, the [[Unidentified bathysphere|bathysphere]] was boarded by [[Roark Garnet/Legends|Roark Garnet]], a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]]. Garnet and the bathysphere's crew fought, and the smuggler neutralized all but one [[Unidentified Imperial (bathysphere)|member]]. The altercation also caused the craft to spin out of control. The pair wrestled for control of the vessel; first the Imperial gained the upper hand and stabilized the bathysphere, only for Garnet to take advantage of his fatigue and take the wheel, narrowly avoiding crashing the bathysphere into one of the planet's native life forms&mdash;an act that shocked the Imperial since he believed that there were no life forms on the planet. The bathysphere's [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsors]] then failed, exposing the craft to the planet's full [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]]. Garnet managed to repair the repulsors and stabilize the craft.<ref name="RPG" />

==Behind the scenes==
This planet appeared only in an example scenario in the [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|first edition]] core book of [[West End Games]]'s ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' published in [[1987]].
